title: General Manager
salary_range: Level 21 with starting pay of Rs. 67400/-
summary: HPSCB invites applications for the post of General Manager on a deputation basis. Candidates must possess a graduation degree along with substantial banking experience and meet specific rank and age criteria. Applications must be submitted through the proper channel by December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: At least 10 years of work experience as an officer with NABARD or Nationalized Banks.
Should not be below the rank of Assistant General Manager with at least 3 years of experience in that rank.
Age must be between 40 and 56 years.
Must provide an integrity certificate and disciplinary penalty statement from the present employer.
how_to_apply_steps: Prepare the bio-data including expected salary, terms and conditions of deputation, and present salary drawn.
Obtain consent and recommendation from the concerned employer or HOD.
Submit the application through proper channel to the Managing Director, HPSCB.
Send the application via email to recruitment@hpscb.bank.in before the deadline.
